data.title: Camping and Docking at Boca Chita and Elliott Keys
data.description: Day Use Docking at Boca Chita and Elliott Keys: $25.00 Friday - Monday and Federal Holidays. Overnight Camping and Docking at Boca Chita and Elliott Keys: $60.00 per night. Payments must be made on site using the recreation.gov phone app.

data.title: Ride Share Services
data.description: Convoy Point grounds, Jetty Trail, kayak launch, and picnic area open at 7 a.m. and close at 5:30 p.m. If you are using a ride share service for transportation to and from the park, ensure ride share services can be onsite before closing time.

data.title: Boater Awareness
data.description: Please use caution in park waters due to navigational markers that may be missing or moved due to unforeseen circumstances.
